origin.thread_label: Alpha Lab adversarial maintenance / PONSCUPINE stale-action incident

title: Wire Alpha Lab adversarial maintenance into existing autonomous runtime
objective: Implement the smallest bounded runtime wiring that makes the owner-approved Meme Alpha adversarial maintainer an event-driven and heartbeat-eligible task type inside the EXISTING Meme Alpha Supervisor/runtime, routes qualified findings to existing adjudication/remediation owners, and adversarially retests fixes. Reproduce the 2026-09-17 PONSCUPINE stale-action incident as the first regression: historical market state must never reach a present-tense actionable label without a same-run exact-CA live observation gate. Reuse the existing Memes v3 autonomous workstream and Codex/remediation machinery; create no parallel scheduler, scanner, scorer, ledger, forecast engine, trading authority, API budget or merge authority.
allowed_change_scope: Donh91/Investering-Framework-Archive-v1:research/api_agent/meme_alpha/** only for implementation/readback fields consistent with already owner-approved semantics

evidence.summary: Owner-approved adversarial role exists but does not itself prove runtime selection or routing.
Canonical design requires attack -> reproduce -> classify -> route -> verify/retest without a parallel engine.
Existing runtime already owns 4-hour heartbeat, event-driven execution, bounded one-task runs, NOOP behavior, budget and model routing.
Existing CODEX_READY autonomous Alpha workstream is the dependency/host and must be reused rather than duplicated.

evidence.ref: GitHub issue #1087 P0 stale-action incident addendum
evidence.summary: PONSCUPINE current action inherited an old approximately 0.9M market-cap observation; exact-CA live refresh later showed approximately 20K and materially changed the action.

reproduction: From fresh main, prove that the adversarial skill and canonical addendum exist, then trace the actual Meme Alpha runtime/supervisor task-selection path. The defect is reproduced if no production runtime path selects an ADVERSARIAL_MAINTENANCE/ADVERSARIAL_REPLAY task and/or if a fixture containing a historical PONSCUPINE market snapshot can still render a present-tense actionable label without a same-run exact-CA/chain/canonical-pool live observation PASS. First check whether the existing Memes v3 autonomous workstream has already implemented equivalent wiring; if yes, link/reuse it and NOOP duplicate code. If its host runtime is not yet landed, preserve this candidate as a dependency-aware follow-up and do not build a parallel runtime.

positive: Existing Meme Alpha Supervisor/runtime can select exactly one bounded ADVERSARIAL_MAINTENANCE or ADVERSARIAL_REPLAY task on an eligible event without a new scheduler.

A reproduced P0/P1 finding routes through existing adjudication/remediation ownership and records a bounded repair/retest lifecycle without giving the adversarial role self-adjudication or merge authority.
PONSCUPINE regression with a stale historical market snapshot forces a new same-run exact-CA live observation before any present-tense action can render.
After a bounded fix fixture, the original adversarial reproduction and one neighboring variant both pass before closure.
P2/P3 qualified findings can remain SHADOW without generating code work or user alert spam.
No eligible adversarial work produces a deterministic NOOP with zero model/API calls, preserving existing runtime budget behavior.
Implementation reuses the existing Memes v3 autonomous workstream, Prospective Evidence, research red-team and Codex/remediation owners rather than duplicating them.
negative: A stale prior price/MC/FDV/liquidity snapshot must never satisfy a present-tense action request.
Missing exact CA, chain, canonical pool or required liquidity must fail closed for current actionable output.
FDV must not silently substitute for missing MC and UNKNOWN must not become zero or a carried-forward value.
A fresh HTTP/API fetch with stale provider payload timestamp must not satisfy ACTION_LIVE.
A multi-token current ranking must not render an actionable label for any candidate lacking its own same-run live observation PASS.
The adversarial role must not create a parallel scheduler, scanner, scorer, evidence ledger, forecast engine or repair authority.
The adversarial role must not self-adjudicate, self-merge, emit trades, change portfolio logic, market gates, model weights, API budget or canonical authority.
If the existing autonomous workstream host is not implemented yet, this task must not bypass it by creating a second runtime.
